steps.en: Slice the onion thinly. Cut long beef slices into bite-sized pieces and grate the ginger.
steps.zh: 洋蔥切幼條；牛肉片太長可剪成易入口大小，薑磨成蓉。

steps.en: Combine water, soy sauce, mirin, sake, sugar and dashi in a pan. Add onion and simmer over medium heat for 5–7 minutes until soft.
steps.zh: 將水、醬油、味醂、清酒、糖及鰹魚粉放入鍋中，加入洋蔥，中火煮5–7分鐘至軟。

steps.en: Stir in ginger. Add beef a few slices at a time so it does not clump. Simmer 3–5 minutes until fully cooked.
steps.zh: 加入薑蓉拌勻，再逐片加入牛肉避免黏成一團；煮3–5分鐘至熟透。

steps.en: Serve over hot rice with some cooking liquid. Keep the sauce slightly loose so it can soak into the rice.
steps.zh: 牛肉及洋蔥鋪在熱飯上，淋上少量湯汁；醬汁保留少許流動感，方便拌飯。

notes.en: If you do not have sake, replace it with 2 tbsp extra water. Pickled ginger or spring onion makes a good topping.
notes.zh: 沒有清酒可用額外2湯匙水代替。可配紅薑絲或蔥花。

title.zh: 煙頰肉車打芝士卡邦尼

steps.en: Finely grate the cheddar. Whisk with whole eggs, yolks, cream if using, and plenty of black pepper until smooth.
steps.zh: 車打芝士幼刨，與全蛋、蛋黃、可選忌廉及黑椒拌勻至順滑。

steps.en: Put diced guanciale in a cold pan. Cook over medium-low heat for 7–10 minutes until golden and crisp. Keep the rendered fat in the pan.
steps.zh: 煙頰肉切粒，冷鍋下鍋，以中小火煎7–10分鐘至金黃香脆，保留鍋中的油。

steps.en: Boil spaghetti in salted water until al dente. Reserve about 200 ml pasta water, then drain.
steps.zh: 意粉以鹽水煮至彈牙，留起約200毫升意粉水後瀝乾。

steps.en: Turn off the heat. Toss pasta in the guanciale fat, wait 30–45 seconds, then add 2–3 tbsp pasta water. Slowly add the egg mixture while tossing. Loosen gradually with pasta water until glossy.
steps.zh: 熄火後將意粉拌入煙頰肉油，等30–45秒，加入2–3湯匙意粉水。邊拌邊慢慢加入蛋液，再逐少加意粉水至醬汁光亮掛麵。

steps.en: Fold in the crispy guanciale and more black pepper. Taste before adding salt; the meat and cheddar are salty.
steps.zh: 拌入香脆煙頰肉及額外黑椒。先試味才加鹽，煙頰肉和芝士已有鹹味。

notes.en: Keep the pan off the heat when adding eggs so they form a creamy sauce rather than scrambled eggs.
notes.zh: 加入蛋液時必須離火，令蛋液成為忌廉狀醬汁而不是炒蛋。

name.en: Chicken, half a chicken cut into pieces

steps.en: Cook guanciale in a pan over medium heat until golden. Lift it out and keep the fat in the pan.
steps.zh: 煙頰肉以中火煎至金黃，先盛起並保留鍋中的油。

steps.en: Pat chicken dry, season, and brown in the guanciale fat. Turn to colour the sides, then set aside; it will finish cooking in the sauce.
steps.zh: 雞件印乾並調味，用煙頰肉油煎至表面上色後盛起，稍後在醬汁中煮熟。

steps.en: Add butter, onion, garlic and mushrooms. Cook until the onion softens and the mushrooms begin to brown. Add wine if using and scrape up the browned bits.
steps.zh: 鍋中加入牛油、洋蔥、蒜頭和蘑菇，炒至洋蔥軟、蘑菇略為金黃。可加白酒並刮起鍋底焦香。

steps.en: Add stock and thyme, return chicken, cover and simmer gently until cooked through. Stir in cream and Dijon mustard; simmer uncovered for 5–8 minutes until the sauce lightly thickens.
steps.zh: 加入雞湯和百里香，放回雞件，蓋上鍋蓋以小火煮至熟透。加入忌廉及第戎芥末，開蓋煮5–8分鐘至醬汁略稠。

steps.en: Return guanciale for the final 1–2 minutes. Serve with cooked rice and keep the sauce slightly loose so it can coat the rice.
steps.zh: 最後1–2分鐘放回煙頰肉。配白飯享用，醬汁不要收得太乾，方便拌飯。

notes.en: Taste before salting because guanciale and stock both add salt. Check chicken at the thickest part.
notes.zh: 煙頰肉和雞湯都有鹹味，最後試味才加鹽。雞肉要檢查最厚位置是否熟透。

title.zh: 蒜香芝士大蝦凱撒沙律

steps.en: Pat prawns dry and season lightly. Pan-fry over medium heat for about 1–2 minutes per side, until opaque and cooked through. Cool slightly.
steps.zh: 大蝦印乾並輕輕調味，以中火每面煎約1–2分鐘至不透明熟透，稍為放涼。

steps.en: Stir mayonnaise, garlic, lemon juice, mustard, Worcestershire sauce, Parmesan and olive oil together. Add a little cold water if needed to loosen.
steps.zh: 蛋黃醬、蒜蓉、檸檬汁、芥末、喼汁、巴馬臣芝士及橄欖油拌勻；太稠可加少量凍水。

steps.en: Wash and thoroughly dry the lettuce. Toss with cucumber and about half the dressing. Top with prawns and croutons, then finish with the remaining dressing and black pepper.
steps.zh: 生菜洗淨並徹底瀝乾，與青瓜及一半沙律醬拌勻。放上大蝦和麵包粒，再加餘下沙律醬及黑椒。

notes.en: For a less rich dressing, add a little more lemon juice. Parmesan is closer to classic Caesar flavour than cheddar.
notes.zh: 想清爽一點可加少許檸檬汁。巴馬臣芝士比車打芝士更接近經典凱撒醬味道。

steps.en: Boil pasta in salted water until al dente. Reserve about 200 ml cooking water, then drain.
steps.zh: 意粉以鹽水煮至彈牙，留起約200毫升意粉水後瀝乾。

steps.en: Slice mushrooms. Heat olive oil and butter in a pan; cook over medium-high heat for 5–7 minutes until golden.
steps.zh: 蘑菇切片。平底鑊加橄欖油及牛油，中大火煎5–7分鐘至金黃。

steps.en: Add garlic and cook for 30 seconds. Stir in cream and 100 ml pasta water; simmer gently for 1–2 minutes. Add cheddar and stir until melted.
steps.zh: 加入蒜蓉炒30秒，加入忌廉及100毫升意粉水，小火煮1–2分鐘。加入車打芝士拌至融化。

steps.en: Fold in drained tuna, pasta and spinach. Add more pasta water a little at a time until the sauce coats the pasta. Season with black pepper.
steps.zh: 拌入瀝乾吞拿魚、意粉及菠菜。逐少加意粉水至醬汁掛麵，最後以黑椒調味。

notes.en: Brown the mushrooms before adding cream. Add tuna near the end to keep it in pieces.
notes.zh: 蘑菇先煎香才加忌廉；吞拿魚最後加入，可保留肉塊口感。

steps.en: Heat oil and half the butter. Cook mushrooms in batches over medium-high heat until deeply golden, 8–12 minutes. Reserve a handful for garnish.
steps.zh: 加熱橄欖油及一半牛油，分批以中大火煎蘑菇8–12分鐘至深金黃色，留起少量作裝飾。

steps.en: Add remaining butter and leek; cook 5–6 minutes until soft. Add garlic and thyme and cook for 30 seconds.
steps.zh: 加入餘下牛油及韭蔥，炒5–6分鐘至軟。加入蒜蓉和百里香再炒30秒。

steps.en: Add potatoes, mushrooms and stock. Bring to a boil, then simmer for 15–20 minutes until the potatoes are tender.
steps.zh: 加入薯仔、蘑菇及湯底，煮滾後轉小火煮15–20分鐘至薯仔軟腍。

steps.en: Blend until smooth. Stir in cream over low heat; season with salt and black pepper. Add hot stock or water if the soup is too thick.
steps.zh: 將湯打至滑身，以小火拌入忌廉，再用鹽和黑椒調味。太稠可加熱湯或水調整。

notes.en: Reserve a few browned mushrooms for topping. Blend hot liquids carefully in batches.
notes.zh: 留起少量煎香蘑菇作配料。用攪拌機處理熱湯時要分批並小心防止濺出。

title.en: Sichuan-style sesame soup dan dan noodles

steps.en: Brown pork in a little oil. Add ginger and garlic; fry until fragrant. Add preserved mustard greens and cook for 2 minutes. Season lightly with soy sauce.
steps.zh: 少油將豬肉碎炒至微金黃，加入薑蓉和蒜蓉炒香，再加入芽菜碎炒2分鐘，以少量生抽調味。

steps.en: Mix sesame paste with soy sauce, vinegar and sugar. Gradually whisk in a little warm stock until smooth.
steps.zh: 芝麻醬與生抽、醋及糖拌勻，逐少加入暖雞湯攪至順滑。

steps.en: Heat the remaining stock. Stir in the sesame mixture and Sichuan pepper if using. Keep at a gentle simmer; do not boil hard.
steps.zh: 加熱餘下雞湯，拌入芝麻醬及可選花椒粉，以微滾方式加熱，不要大火滾煮。

steps.en: Cook noodles separately and divide between bowls. Ladle in broth, add pork topping and spring onions. Add chilli oil to taste.
steps.zh: 麵條另鍋煮熟後分入碗中，加入湯底、肉臊及蔥花，按口味加辣椒油。

notes.en: For one spicy and one mild bowl, divide the broth before adding chilli oil.
notes.zh: 想一碗辣、一碗不辣，可先分開湯底，再只在辣味那碗加入辣椒油。

steps.en: Lower eggs into boiling water and cook for 6–7 minutes for jammy yolks. Transfer to ice-cold water, cool, then peel carefully.
steps.zh: 雞蛋放入滾水煮6–7分鐘做溏心蛋，立即放入冰水降溫，冷卻後小心剝殼。

steps.en: Warm soy sauce, water and sugar until the sugar dissolves. Remove from heat; stir in vinegar, sesame oil, garlic, spring onion, sesame seeds and optional chilli.
steps.zh: 生抽、水及糖加熱至糖溶化後離火，拌入醋、麻油、蒜蓉、蔥花、芝麻及可選辣椒。

steps.en: Place peeled eggs in a container and pour over the warm, not boiling, marinade. Chill for at least 30–40 minutes, turning once or twice.
steps.zh: 剝殼蛋放入盒中，倒入暖而非滾燙的醃汁，冷藏至少30–40分鐘，中途翻動一至兩次。

steps.en: Halve the eggs and spoon some marinade over. Serve with rice or noodles.
steps.zh: 雞蛋切半，淋上少量醃汁，配飯或麵享用。

notes.en: Keep marinating eggs refrigerated. For runny eggs, follow UK advice for egg assurance marks and vulnerable groups.
notes.zh: 醃蛋須放雪櫃保存。食用溏心蛋時，請留意英國對蛋品認證及高風險人士的建議。

steps.en: Soften the onion in a little oil and cool. Mix beef, onion, egg, breadcrumbs, milk, salt and pepper gently. Shape into three oval patties; press out air pockets.
steps.zh: 少油炒軟洋蔥並放涼。牛肉碎、洋蔥、雞蛋、麵包糠、牛奶、鹽及黑椒輕輕拌勻，分成三份橢圓形漢堡扒並壓走空氣。

steps.en: Heat a lightly oiled pan over medium heat. Brown patties for 3–4 minutes per side, then lower heat and cook through. Set aside to rest.
steps.zh: 平底鑊加少量油以中火煎漢堡扒，每面3–4分鐘上色，再轉小火煮至熟透，盛起稍作休息。

steps.en: Add ketchup, Worcestershire sauce and stock to the pan. Simmer and scrape up browned bits. Stir cornflour with cold water, then add gradually until glossy and thickened.
steps.zh: 鍋中加入茄汁、喼汁及牛肉湯，煮滾並刮起鍋底焦香。粟粉加凍水拌勻，逐少加入煮至醬汁光亮濃稠。

steps.en: Return patties to the sauce briefly to coat. Serve with rice or mashed potato.
steps.zh: 漢堡扒放回醬汁中略煮並裹上醬汁，配飯或薯蓉享用。

notes.en: For home food safety, cook minced-meat patties thoroughly; do not serve burgers pink.
notes.zh: 家中烹調肉碎漢堡扒須徹底煮熟，不應以粉紅色或半生狀態上桌。

steps.en: Season chicken and brown in a heavy pan with a little oil. Remove and set aside.
steps.zh: 雞肉調味後以少量油在厚底鍋煎至表面上色，盛起備用。

steps.en: Add onion, carrot and potatoes. Cook for 5 minutes, then add garlic and thyme for 30 seconds.
steps.zh: 加入洋蔥、紅蘿蔔及薯仔炒5分鐘，再加蒜頭和百里香炒30秒。

steps.en: Pour in stock and return chicken. Cover and simmer gently for 25–30 minutes until the vegetables are tender and chicken is cooked through.
steps.zh: 加入雞湯並放回雞肉，蓋上鍋蓋小火燴25–30分鐘，至蔬菜軟腍及雞肉熟透。

steps.en: Stir in cream and simmer uncovered for 4–5 minutes. Taste and adjust seasoning.
steps.zh: 拌入忌廉，開蓋煮4–5分鐘，試味並調整調味。

notes.en: Keep the simmer gentle after adding cream. Check chicken at the thickest part.
notes.zh: 加入忌廉後保持小火微滾；雞肉要檢查最厚位置是否熟透。

title.en: Juicy Hong Kong curry beef brisket
title.zh: 多汁港式咖喱牛腩薯仔

name.en: Bone-in beef short ribs or brisket

steps.en: Blanch beef for 5 minutes and rinse. Pressure-cook with ginger, half the onion and enough water to meet your cooker’s minimum liquid requirement for 35–40 minutes on high. Natural-release for 15 minutes. Reserve the cooking liquid and skim excess fat.
steps.zh: 牛肉汆水5分鐘後沖洗。與薑、半個洋蔥及符合壓力煲最低液體要求的水一起高壓煮35–40分鐘，自然洩壓15分鐘。保留牛肉湯並撇走多餘油脂。

steps.en: In a separate pot, soften the remaining onion in oil for 4–5 minutes. Add garlic and ginger for 1 minute. Add curry powder and fry for 30 seconds, then stir in curry paste, satay sauce and chu hou paste.
steps.zh: 另鍋加油炒軟餘下洋蔥4–5分鐘，加入蒜及薑炒1分鐘。加入咖喱粉炒30秒，再拌入咖喱醬、沙嗲醬及柱侯醬。

steps.en: Add beef, oyster sauce, soy sauce, rock sugar and 700–800 ml reserved beef broth. Add potatoes and carrot. Cover and simmer gently for 15–20 minutes until the potatoes are tender.
steps.zh: 加入牛肉、蠔油、生抽、冰糖及700–800毫升牛肉湯，再加薯仔和紅蘿蔔。蓋上鍋蓋小火煮15–20分鐘至薯仔軟腍。

steps.en: Simmer uncovered for about 5 minutes. Keep it loose for rice. For a thicker café-style gravy, stir in a little cornflour slurry; thin with hot broth or water if needed.
steps.zh: 開蓋煮約5分鐘。配飯的多汁版本不要收得太乾。想要茶餐廳掛身咖喱汁，可加少量粟粉水；太稠則加熱湯或水。

notes.en: Use the beef cooking liquid for a deeper gravy. Keep the pressure-cooker minimum liquid requirement in mind.
notes.zh: 用炆牛腩的湯汁做咖喱底會更香。壓力煲液體量須符合機器最低要求。

title.zh: 羅勒牛油雞扒配薯蓉蘑菇

steps.en: Boil peeled, chopped potatoes for 10–12 minutes until tender. Drain well, mash with butter and warm milk, and season.
steps.zh: 薯仔去皮切件，煮10–12分鐘至軟，瀝乾後加入牛油及暖牛奶壓成薯蓉並調味。

steps.en: Season chicken. Heat a little oil over medium-high and sear skin-side down for 5–6 minutes until golden. Turn, add basil butter, cover and cook 6–8 minutes until cooked through. Rest for 3 minutes.
steps.zh: 雞髀調味。少油中大火先煎皮面5–6分鐘至金黃，反面加入羅勒牛油，蓋上煮6–8分鐘至熟透，靜置3分鐘。

steps.en: Slice mushrooms. Sauté with basil butter and minced garlic for 5–6 minutes until soft and golden.
steps.zh: 蘑菇切片，與羅勒牛油及蒜蓉同炒5–6分鐘至軟身金黃。

steps.en: Mix softened butter with minced garlic, spread on bread and toast in a pan or under a grill for 3–5 minutes until golden. Serve with chicken, mash and mushrooms.
steps.zh: 軟化牛油與蒜蓉拌勻，塗在麵包上，以平底鑊或焗爐上火烤3–5分鐘至金黃。配雞髀、薯蓉及蘑菇上桌。

notes.en: Check the thickest part of the chicken for thorough cooking.
notes.zh: 雞肉最厚位置須確認熟透。

title.en: Soy-glazed wings, mushroom risotto & pork collar
title.zh: 豉油雞翼、蘑菇意大利飯及豬頸肉

steps.en: Roast or air-fry wings at 200°C for 35–40 minutes, turning halfway. For a light glaze, brush with a little honey and butter for the final 5 minutes.
steps.zh: 雞翼以200°C焗或氣炸35–40分鐘，中途翻面。最後5分鐘可掃少量蜜糖牛油作薄薄糖衣。

steps.en: Season pork collar lightly with pepper and a little paprika. Sear in a very hot pan for 3–4 minutes per side, then rest for 5 minutes and slice.
steps.zh: 豬頸肉以黑椒及少量紅椒粉輕調味。熱鑊每面煎3–4分鐘，靜置5分鐘後切片。

steps.en: Dissolve the stock cube in hot water and keep the stock warm.
steps.zh: 湯粒加入熱水攪溶，保溫備用。

steps.en: Cook bacon until crisp and set aside. Brown mushrooms, then soften diced onion and garlic. Stir in rice for 1–2 minutes. Add warm stock a ladle at a time, stirring often, until creamy and tender, about 18–20 minutes. Finish with butter, Parmesan, bacon and black pepper.
steps.zh: 煙肉煎脆後盛起。蘑菇煎香，再炒軟洋蔥及蒜。加入米炒1–2分鐘，逐勺加入暖湯並常攪拌，煮約18–20分鐘至米粒軟身帶滑。最後拌入牛油、芝士、煙肉及黑椒。

title.en: Make the yoghurt sauce and serve

steps.en: Mix yoghurt with grated garlic, lemon juice or vinegar, pepper and a drizzle of olive oil. Serve with wings, sliced pork and risotto.
steps.zh: 乳酪加入蒜蓉、檸檬汁或醋、黑椒及少量橄欖油拌勻，配雞翼、豬頸肉及意大利飯享用。

notes.en: Keep the stock warm so the rice cooks evenly. Season the pork sparingly because the wings and bacon are already salty.
notes.zh: 湯底保持暖熱可令米飯均勻受熱。雞翼及煙肉已有鹹味，豬肉調味宜輕手。

steps.en: Melt a little butter with the olive oil. Fry sliced mushrooms until golden, then remove and set aside.
steps.zh: 少量牛油與橄欖油加熱，將蘑菇片煎至金黃後盛起。

steps.en: Add some butter to the pan. Cook diced onion until translucent, then add garlic and cook briefly.
steps.zh: 鍋中加入部分牛油，炒洋蔥至透明，再加入蒜蓉略炒。

steps.en: Add rice and stir for 1–2 minutes until the grains look slightly translucent. Add wine if using and cook until absorbed.
steps.zh: 加入米炒1–2分鐘至米粒邊緣略透明。可加入白酒煮至吸收。

steps.en: Add hot stock one ladle at a time, stirring often and waiting until mostly absorbed before adding more. Continue for about 18–20 minutes until creamy and tender.
steps.zh: 每次加入一勺熱湯，常攪拌並待大部分吸收後再加。煮約18–20分鐘至飯粒軟身、整體滑順。

steps.en: Stir in mushrooms, remaining butter, Parmesan and optional cream. Season with salt and black pepper and serve immediately.
steps.zh: 拌入蘑菇、餘下牛油、巴馬臣芝士及可選忌廉，以鹽和黑椒調味，立即上桌。

notes.en: Keep extra hot stock nearby; rice may need a little more or less depending on the pan and heat.
notes.zh: 多準備少量熱湯備用；實際用量會因鍋具及火力不同而略有差異。

steps.en: Soften onion, carrot and celery in olive oil for 8–10 minutes. Add garlic, then brown the beef. Stir in tomato paste and cook for 2 minutes. Add wine and reduce, then add tomatoes and stock. Simmer gently for 35–45 minutes; stir in 150 ml milk near the end.
steps.zh: 橄欖油炒軟洋蔥、紅蘿蔔及西芹8–10分鐘，加入蒜頭，再加入牛肉碎炒熟。拌入茄膏炒2分鐘，加紅酒煮至收乾，再加番茄及牛肉湯小火煮35–45分鐘。接近完成時拌入150毫升牛奶。

steps.en: Melt butter in a saucepan. Stir in flour and cook for 1 minute. Gradually whisk in warm milk until smooth and thick. Stir in 80 g Parmesan, salt, white pepper and a little nutmeg.
steps.zh: 小鍋融化牛油，加入麵粉炒1分鐘。逐少加入暖牛奶並不停攪拌至順滑濃稠，拌入80克巴馬臣芝士、鹽、白胡椒及少量肉豆蔻。

steps.en: Heat oven to 180°C fan. In a baking dish, layer a little meat sauce, lasagne sheets, béchamel and mozzarella. Repeat, finishing with béchamel, mozzarella and the remaining Parmesan.
steps.zh: 焗爐預熱至180°C熱風。焗盤底放少量肉醬，再交替鋪千層麵片、白汁及水牛芝士，重複至材料用完，頂層放白汁、芝士及餘下巴馬臣。

steps.en: Bake for 35–40 minutes until bubbling and golden. Rest for 10–15 minutes before slicing.
steps.zh: 焗35–40分鐘至冒泡金黃，出爐後靜置10–15分鐘再切件。

notes.en: Cook the meat sauce until thick enough to hold between layers. Resting helps the slices stay neat.
notes.zh: 肉醬煮至濃稠才鋪層，靜置後切件會更完整。

steps.en: Season chicken and brown in a pan. Add onion, carrot and potatoes; cook for a few minutes until fragrant.
steps.zh: 雞肉調味後煎至上色。加入洋蔥、紅蘿蔔及薯仔炒數分鐘至香。

steps.en: Melt butter and stir in curry powder for about 20 seconds. Add turmeric, garlic, coconut milk and milk. Mix and bring to a gentle simmer.
steps.zh: 牛油融化後加入咖喱粉炒約20秒，再加入黃薑粉、蒜蓉、椰奶及牛奶拌勻，煮至微滾。

steps.en: Return chicken and vegetables to the sauce. Cover and simmer gently for 20–25 minutes until chicken is cooked through and vegetables are tender.
steps.zh: 雞肉及蔬菜放回醬汁中，蓋上鍋蓋小火煮20–25分鐘，至雞肉熟透、蔬菜軟腍。

steps.en: Serve the chicken and vegetables over freshly cooked rice, with plenty of the coconut turmeric sauce.
steps.zh: 雞肉及蔬菜放在新煮好的白飯上，淋上足量椰香黃薑葡汁。

notes.en: Use 1 tbsp curry powder plus 1 tsp turmeric for a more turmeric-forward, mild Portuguese-style flavour.
notes.zh: 想突出黃薑香、令咖喱味柔和，可用1湯匙咖喱粉配1茶匙黃薑粉。

name.en: Scallion-ginger sauce: ginger, spring onion, salt and hot oil
name.zh: 薑蓉蔥油：薑蓉、蔥花、鹽及熱油

name.en: Chilli sauce: red chilli, ginger, garlic, lime and sugar
name.zh: 辣椒醬：紅辣椒、薑、蒜、青檸及糖

steps.en: Pat the chicken dry and rub all over with salt. Leave for 15 minutes.
steps.zh: 雞髀抹乾，均勻抹上鹽，醃15分鐘。

steps.en: Put ginger, spring onions, garlic and Shaoxing wine in a pot with enough water to cover the chicken. Bring just to a simmer, add chicken, then keep the liquid around 85–90°C without a rolling boil. Cook until the thickest part reaches 74°C.
steps.zh: 鍋中加入薑、蔥、蒜、紹興酒及足以蓋過雞肉的水，煮至微滾後放入雞髀。保持約85–90°C，不要大滾；煮至雞肉最厚位置達74°C。

steps.en: Transfer chicken to iced water for 5 minutes for springy skin. Drain, cool, then chop into serving pieces.
steps.zh: 雞髀撈起放入冰水浸5分鐘令雞皮爽滑，瀝乾放涼後斬件。

steps.en: Rinse and drain rice. Render chicken fat in a pan; gently fry grated ginger and garlic. Add rice and stir for 2 minutes. Transfer to a rice cooker with 200–220 ml strained poaching broth, chicken powder and optional lemongrass. Cook normally, then rest 10 minutes before fluffing.
steps.zh: 米洗淨瀝乾。鍋中煮出雞油，慢火炒香薑蓉及蒜蓉，加入米炒約2分鐘。放入飯煲，加200–220毫升隔渣雞湯、雞粉及可選香茅，按正常模式煮飯，煮好焗10分鐘再翻鬆。

steps.en: For scallion-ginger sauce, mix ginger, spring onion and salt, then pour over hot oil. Blend or finely pound chilli sauce ingredients to taste. Serve chicken and rice with both sauces and dark soy.
steps.zh: 薑蓉、蔥花及鹽拌勻後淋上熱油。辣椒醬材料按口味搗碎或攪勻。雞肉及雞油飯配兩款醬汁和老抽享用。

notes.en: This version uses chicken legs and their poaching broth for the rice. Keep the poaching liquid at a gentle simmer and check temperature with a clean probe.
notes.zh: 此版本使用雞髀，並以浸雞湯煮飯。浸煮時保持微滾，並用清潔探針檢查中心溫度。

title.en: Hong Kong curry fish balls & radish

steps.en: Peel and cut radish into large chunks. Simmer in water for 15–20 minutes until a chopstick enters with slight resistance. Reserve 500 ml cooking water.
steps.zh: 白蘿蔔去皮切大件，清水煮15–20分鐘至筷子可插入但仍有少許阻力。留起500毫升蘿蔔水。

steps.en: Heat oil over medium heat. Fry shallot for 30–45 seconds, add onion for 2–3 minutes, then garlic for 30 seconds. Lower heat and stir-fry curry paste, satay, chu hou and turmeric for 1–2 minutes. Add Shaoxing wine.
steps.zh: 中火燒油，先炒乾蔥30–45秒，加入洋蔥炒2–3分鐘，再加蒜蓉炒30秒。轉中小火，加入咖喱醬、沙茶醬、柱侯醬及黃薑粉炒1–2分鐘，再加紹興酒。

steps.en: Add 500 ml reserved radish water, oyster sauce, soy, sugar and chicken powder. Add radish; liquid should reach about two-thirds up the pieces. Cover and simmer gently for 25–30 minutes, turning occasionally.
steps.zh: 加入500毫升蘿蔔水、蠔油、生抽、糖及雞粉。放入蘿蔔，湯汁約浸到蘿蔔三分之二高度。加蓋小火煮25–30分鐘，期間翻動。

steps.en: Turn off the heat and leave the radish in the curry for 20–30 minutes if time allows. Reheat gently, add fish balls and simmer 8–10 minutes.
steps.zh: 如有時間，熄火讓蘿蔔在咖喱汁中浸20–30分鐘。再用小火翻熱，加入魚蛋煮8–10分鐘。

steps.en: Mix cornflour with water until smooth. Stir in gradually until the sauce is glossy and lightly thickened; you may not need all of it.
steps.zh: 生粉與水拌勻，逐少倒入並攪拌至醬汁光亮、略為濃稠；未必需要全部生粉水。

notes.en: For deeper flavour, cool and reheat the radish in the curry before adding the fish balls. Adjust salt and heat to taste.
notes.zh: 想蘿蔔更入味，可先連咖喱汁放涼再翻熱，然後才加入魚蛋。鹹度和辣度按口味調整。

steps.en: Slice beef thinly across the grain. Mix with marinade ingredients and leave for 15 minutes.
steps.zh: 牛肉逆紋切薄片，加入醃料拌勻，醃15分鐘。

steps.en: Combine light soy, dark soy, oyster sauce, sugar and white pepper.
steps.zh: 生抽、老抽、蠔油、糖及白胡椒拌勻。

steps.en: Heat a wok until hot, add oil and stir-fry beef quickly until just changing colour. Remove to a plate.
steps.zh: 鑊燒熱下油，快速炒牛肉至剛轉色，先盛起。

steps.en: Add a little oil if needed. Stir-fry garlic and black beans until fragrant, then add onion and peppers and cook until just tender.
steps.zh: 如需要可再加少許油，炒香蒜蓉及豆豉，加入洋蔥和青紅椒炒至略軟。

steps.en: Loosen noodles gently. Add to the wok over high heat with the sauce and toss until hot and evenly coloured. Return beef and add spring onions; toss briefly and serve.
steps.zh: 河粉輕輕鬆開，加入鑊中轉大火，倒入醬汁炒至熱透均勻上色。牛肉回鑊，加入蔥段兜勻即上碟。

notes.en: If chilled noodles are stuck together, microwave for about 30 seconds or steam briefly before stir-frying. Cook beef in batches if the wok is crowded.
notes.zh: 冷藏河粉黏成團時，可先微波約30秒或略蒸再炒。鑊內太擠時分批炒牛肉，較易保持嫩滑。

title.en: Chinese-style creamy napa cabbage with bacon

name.en: Napa cabbage, cut into large pieces

steps.en: Start bacon in a cold pan and cook over medium heat until it releases fat and is lightly crisp. Remove some fat if needed, leaving about 1 tbsp.
steps.zh: 冷鑊下煙肉，中火煎至出油並略脆。如油太多可倒走，留約1湯匙。

steps.en: Add ginger, garlic and onion; stir-fry for 1–2 minutes until the onion starts to soften.
steps.zh: 加入薑絲、蒜蓉及洋蔥，中火炒1–2分鐘至洋蔥開始軟。

steps.en: Add napa cabbage and stir-fry over high heat for 2–3 minutes. Add stock, cover and cook for 3 minutes.
steps.zh: 加入津白大火炒2–3分鐘，加入雞湯後加蓋煮3分鐘。

steps.en: Pour in milk and add chicken powder, sugar and white pepper. Simmer gently for 4–5 minutes; avoid a hard boil.
steps.zh: 倒入牛奶，加入雞粉、糖及白胡椒，中小火煮4–5分鐘；避免大滾。

steps.en: Mix cornflour and water until smooth. Stir the sauce while adding about two-thirds of the slurry slowly; cook 30–60 seconds, adding more only if needed. Taste before adding salt. Sprinkle reserved crisp bacon on top.
steps.zh: 生粉與水拌勻。一邊攪汁一邊慢慢加入約三分之二生粉水，煮30–60秒；不夠稠才再加。試味後才加鹽，最後撒上預留的脆煙肉。

notes.en: Keep the sauce gently simmering when adding the slurry. Serve with rice and leave enough sauce to spoon over it.
notes.zh: 加入生粉水時保持小火微滾。配白飯享用，可保留較多醬汁拌飯。

steps.en: Boil spaghetti in salted water until al dente. Reserve at least 150 ml pasta water, then drain.
steps.zh: 意粉以鹽水煮至彈牙，留起至少150毫升意粉水後瀝乾。

steps.en: Melt butter over medium-low heat. Add onion and cook for 2–3 minutes until soft. Add garlic and cook for 30 seconds.
steps.zh: 中小火融化牛油，加入洋蔥炒2–3分鐘至軟，再加入蒜蓉炒30秒。

steps.en: Add white wine and reduce for 30–45 seconds. Stir in cream, 100 ml pasta water, soy sauce, sugar and black pepper; warm gently.
steps.zh: 加入白酒煮30–45秒至略為收乾。加入忌廉、100毫升意粉水、醬油、糖及黑椒，輕輕加熱。

steps.en: Turn off the heat. Stir in about 80 g cod roe until the sauce turns coral pink. Do not boil the roe.
steps.zh: 熄火，拌入約80克明太子至醬汁呈珊瑚粉紅色。加入明太子後不要煮滾。

steps.en: Add spaghetti and toss until glossy, adding reserved pasta water a little at a time as needed. Top with remaining roe, nori and optional spring onion; finish with a few drops of lemon if desired.
steps.zh: 加入意粉拌至光亮，按需要逐少加入意粉水。放上餘下明太子、紫菜及可選蔥花；喜歡的話最後加幾滴檸檬汁。

notes.en: Aim for a silky, loose sauce rather than a thick cream coating. Adding the roe off the heat helps keep its texture smooth.
notes.zh: 醬汁以絲滑流動為佳，不要煮到像濃稠白汁。離火後才加入明太子，可避免口感變粗。

title.en: Honey black pepper beef rice bowls

name.en: Steak, thinly sliced across the grain

steps.en: Slice steak 5–10 mm thick across the grain. Mix with soy sauce, pepper, cornflour, water and oil. Rest for 15 minutes.
steps.zh: 牛扒逆紋切成約5–10毫米薄片，加入生抽、黑椒、粟粉、水及油拌勻，醃15分鐘。

steps.en: Melt about 10 g butter in a pan over medium heat. Cook onion for 3–5 minutes until soft and lightly golden; remove.
steps.zh: 中火融化約10克牛油，炒洋蔥3–5分鐘至軟身微金黃，盛起備用。

steps.en: Add a little oil and sear beef in two or three batches for about 30–60 seconds per side, just until browned and cooked through. Remove each batch.
steps.zh: 加少許油，將牛肉分兩至三批，每面約煎30–60秒至熟透上色後盛起。

steps.en: Whisk honey, soy, oyster sauce, water, Worcestershire, pepper, garlic and cornflour. Pour into the pan, add onion and simmer 1–2 minutes until lightly glossy. Add a splash of water if too thick.
steps.zh: 蜜糖、生抽、蠔油、水、喼汁、黑椒、蒜蓉及粟粉拌勻，倒入鑊中並加入洋蔥，小火煮1–2分鐘至略為光亮掛匙。太稠可加少量水。

steps.en: Return beef to the pan and toss briefly until coated and hot. Divide rice into bowls, top with beef, onion and sauce, then finish with remaining butter and optional spring onion.
steps.zh: 牛肉回鑊快速兜勻至熱透並裹上醬汁。白飯分碗，鋪上牛肉、洋蔥和醬汁，最後加餘下牛油及可選蔥花。

notes.en: Avoid crowding the pan so the beef sears instead of steaming. Taste the sauce before adding extra salt.
notes.zh: 不要一次過放太多牛肉，避免焗出水而不能煎香。加鹽前先試醬汁味道。

name.en: Dried shiitake mushrooms, soaked and sliced
Firm tofu, cut into thin strips
Wood ear mushrooms, soaked and sliced

steps.en: Soak dried mushrooms until soft, then slice. Cut tofu into thin strips and beat the egg. If using pork, season lightly and toss with a little cornflour.
steps.zh: 乾冬菇浸軟後切絲，豆腐切幼條並打散雞蛋。如用豬肉，輕輕調味並拌少許生粉。

steps.en: Bring stock to a simmer. Add mushrooms, tofu, optional enoki and pork if using. Cook until ingredients are tender and pork is thoroughly cooked.
steps.zh: 高湯煮至微滾，加入冬菇、木耳、豆腐、可選金針菇及豬肉，煮至材料軟身、豬肉熟透。

steps.en: Stir in soy sauce, white pepper and a little dark soy if desired. Mix cornflour with water, then pour in gradually while stirring until lightly thickened.
steps.zh: 加入生抽、白胡椒及可選少量老抽調色。粟粉加水拌勻，邊攪邊逐少倒入至湯略為濃稠。

steps.en: Lower the heat. Slowly drizzle in beaten egg in a thin stream. Pause briefly, then stir gently to form ribbons.
steps.zh: 轉小火，將蛋液慢慢繞圈淋入，稍停片刻後輕輕攪動形成蛋花。

steps.en: Turn off the heat. Stir in vinegar and chilli oil, then taste and adjust acidity, pepper and heat. Garnish with spring onion.
steps.zh: 熄火後加入醋和辣油，試味並調整酸度、胡椒及辣度，最後撒上蔥絲。

notes.en: Adding vinegar off the heat keeps its aroma bright. For a vegetarian version, use vegetable stock and omit pork.
notes.zh: 熄火後才加醋，香氣會更突出。素食版本可用蔬菜高湯並省略豬肉。

title.en: Hong Kong ginger & scallion baked oysters

name.en: Spring onions, white and green parts separated

steps.en: Thaw in the refrigerator or, if sealed, in cold water. Drain and pat very dry with kitchen paper. Dust lightly with cornflour and shake off excess.
steps.zh: 放雪櫃解凍；如包裝密封亦可用凍水解凍。瀝乾後用廚房紙徹底印乾，薄薄撲生粉並抖走多餘粉末。

steps.en: Heat about 2 tbsp oil in a hot pan. Sear oysters in batches with space between them until the surface sets and lightly colours. Remove; they will finish cooking in the sauce.
steps.zh: 熱鑊加入約2湯匙油，生蠔分批下鑊並留空間，煎至表面定形、略帶金黃後盛起，稍後在醬汁中煮熟。

steps.en: Add remaining oil. Fry ginger over medium heat for 2–3 minutes until lightly golden. Add garlic, spring onion whites and optional onion; cook 1–2 minutes. Add wine around the edge of the pan.
steps.zh: 原鑊加入餘下油，中火煎薑片2–3分鐘至略金黃。加入蒜片、蔥白及可選洋蔥炒1–2分鐘，沿鑊邊加入酒。

steps.en: Mix oyster sauce, soy sauces, sugar, pepper and stock. Add to the pan and bring to a gentle simmer. Return oysters, cover and cook until thoroughly cooked; follow package directions and avoid relying on colour or time alone.
steps.zh: 蠔油、生抽、老抽、糖、白胡椒及雞湯拌勻，倒入鑊中煮至微滾。放回生蠔，加蓋煮至徹底熟透；跟隨包裝指示，不要只靠顏色或時間判斷。

steps.en: Add spring onion greens. Stir cornflour with water and add gradually until the sauce lightly coats the oysters.
steps.zh: 加入蔥綠。生粉加水拌勻，逐少加入至醬汁略為掛住蠔身。

notes.en: Frozen oysters can release liquid. Thaw fully, dry well and sear in batches. Cook thoroughly and follow the package’s cooking directions.
notes.zh: 急凍生蠔容易出水，須完全解凍、徹底印乾並分批煎香。請徹底煮熟並依照包裝上的烹調指示。

title.en: Hong Kong tomato, beef & egg over rice

steps.en: Toss beef with 1 tsp soy, a pinch of sugar and cornflour; set aside 15 minutes.
steps.zh: 牛肉拌入1茶匙生抽、少許糖及生粉，醃15分鐘。

steps.en: Heat a little oil in a wok and softly scramble eggs until just set. Remove while still glossy.
steps.zh: 鑊中燒少許油，雞蛋炒至剛凝固仍滑身便盛起。

steps.en: Fry onion and garlic until fragrant. Add tomatoes, ketchup, remaining soy, sugar and stock. Cover and simmer 10–12 minutes until saucy.
steps.zh: 炒香洋蔥及蒜蓉，加入番茄、茄汁、餘下生抽、糖及高湯。加蓋煮10–12分鐘至出汁。

steps.en: Add beef and simmer until cooked through. Return eggs and fold gently. Adjust seasoning and spoon over hot rice.
steps.zh: 加入牛肉煮至熟透，放回雞蛋輕輕拌合。試味後淋在熱飯上。

notes.en: Tomatoes vary in sweetness and juiciness; start with less stock and add more only if needed.
notes.zh: 番茄甜度和出水量不同，可先少加高湯，不夠汁才補加。

title.en: Hong Kong café corn & pork rice

steps.en: Heat oil in a pan. Fry onion and garlic briefly, add pork and cook until browned and cooked through. Season with soy; remove.
steps.zh: 鍋中燒油，略炒洋蔥及蒜蓉，加入豬肉炒至上色熟透，以生抽調味後盛起。

steps.en: Melt butter over low heat. Stir in flour and cook for about 1 minute without browning.
steps.zh: 小火融化牛油，加入麵粉炒約1分鐘，不要炒焦。

steps.en: Whisk in stock gradually until smooth, then add milk and simmer, stirring, until lightly thickened.
steps.zh: 逐少拌入雞湯攪至順滑，再加入牛奶，邊攪邊煮至略稠。

steps.en: Stir in corn and cooked pork; simmer 3–5 minutes. Season with salt, sugar and white pepper. Spoon over hot rice.
steps.zh: 加入粟米及豬肉，小火煮3–5分鐘。以鹽、糖及白胡椒調味，淋在熱飯上。

notes.en: For a richer café-style topping, replace part of the milk with cream. The source versions differ on cream, so it is optional.
notes.zh: 想更濃郁的茶餐廳風味，可用忌廉代替部分牛奶；不同版本比例有別，忌廉可選。

steps.en: Toss pork with soy, wine, a pinch of salt and pepper, and 1 tbsp cornflour. Rest for 15 minutes.
steps.zh: 豬肉拌入生抽、紹興酒、少許鹽及胡椒和1湯匙生粉，醃15分鐘。

steps.en: Mix remaining cornflour, flour, baking powder and enough cold water to make a thick batter. Coat pork and fry in 170°C oil until golden and cooked; drain. Fry a second time briefly for extra crispness.
steps.zh: 餘下生粉、麵粉、泡打粉及適量凍水拌成濃漿。豬肉裹漿後以約170°C油炸至金黃熟透，瀝油；想更脆可快速回鍋再炸。

steps.en: Stir-fry garlic, onion and peppers over high heat until just tender.
steps.zh: 大火炒香蒜頭、洋蔥及青紅椒至略軟。

steps.en: Combine vinegar, sugar, ketchup and water; bring to a simmer. Add a little cornflour slurry to gloss, then toss pork through the sauce just before serving.
steps.zh: 醋、糖、茄汁及水拌勻煮滾，加入少量生粉水煮至光亮。上桌前才放入豬肉快速兜勻。

notes.en: Keep the sauce separate until the last moment to preserve the crisp coating.
notes.zh: 最後才把炸肉拌入醬汁，保持外層酥脆。

name.en: Pork shoulder or fatty minced pork

steps.en: Slice pork thinly or use coarsely minced pork. Mix with shrimp paste, garlic, sugar, soy, cornflour, sesame oil and pepper. Marinate 15–30 minutes.
steps.zh: 豬肉切薄片或用粗絞肉，加入蝦醬、蒜蓉、糖、生抽、生粉、麻油及白胡椒拌勻，醃15–30分鐘。

steps.en: Spread pork in a shallow heatproof plate in an even layer, leaving space for steam to circulate.
steps.zh: 豬肉平均鋪在淺身耐熱碟上，預留空間讓蒸氣流通。

steps.en: Steam over actively simmering water for 12–16 minutes, depending on thickness, until thoroughly cooked. Rest briefly and garnish with spring onion.
steps.zh: 水滾後以中火蒸12–16分鐘，按厚度調整，直至徹底熟透。稍作靜置後撒上蔥花。

notes.en: Shrimp paste is salty; taste the cooked pork before adding any extra salt.
notes.zh: 蝦醬鹹味較重，毋須先加鹽，蒸好試味再調整。

steps.en: Pat chicken dry. Heat oil in a heavy pot and brown chicken in batches; remove excess rendered fat if needed.
steps.zh: 雞件抹乾。厚身鍋燒熱下油，分批煎香雞件；如出油太多可倒走部分。

steps.en: Add garlic and optional onion. Stir in chicken pot sauce over medium heat until fragrant, then return chicken and coat well.
steps.zh: 加入蒜頭及可選洋蔥炒香，中火加入雞煲醬炒出香氣，再放回雞件拌勻。

steps.en: Add stock, cover and simmer gently for 15–20 minutes, turning occasionally, until chicken is thoroughly cooked. Add potato or lotus root early enough to soften.
steps.zh: 加入高湯，加蓋小火煮15–20分鐘，期間翻動，直至雞肉熟透。薯仔或蓮藕要較早加入煮軟。

steps.en: Add optional quick-cooking vegetables and simmer until just tender. Uncover and reduce sauce to your preferred thickness. Garnish with spring onion.
steps.zh: 加入可選易熟蔬菜煮至剛軟，開蓋收汁至喜歡的濃度，撒上蔥段。

notes.en: Serve over a small flame. Add extra broth later to turn the pot into a hotpot.
notes.zh: 可用小火爐保溫。吃到後段加入高湯，便可轉成火鍋。

steps.en: Soak mushrooms until soft. Remove stems and halve. Reserve the soaking liquid; steam mushrooms with sugar and 2 tbsp soaking liquid for 10–12 minutes.
steps.zh: 冬菇浸軟後去蒂切半，留起冬菇水。冬菇拌糖及2湯匙冬菇水先蒸10–12分鐘。

steps.en: Mix chicken with soy, oyster sauce, wine, cornflour and ginger. Add steamed mushrooms and their juices; marinate 20 minutes.
steps.zh: 雞件加入生抽、蠔油、紹興酒、生粉及薑拌勻，加入已蒸冬菇及菇汁，醃20分鐘。

steps.en: Rinse rice and cook in a rice cooker using the usual amount of water, replacing part with strained mushroom liquid.
steps.zh: 米洗淨，按平常水量放入飯煲，可用隔渣冬菇水代替部分清水。

steps.en: Steam chicken and mushrooms over boiling water for about 18–25 minutes, until chicken is thoroughly cooked. Serve over the rice with the steaming juices.
steps.zh: 水滾後蒸雞及冬菇約18–25分鐘，按雞件大小調整至熟透。連蒸出的汁淋在飯上享用。

notes.en: The final history update specifies steaming the mushrooms first and using their juices with the chicken.
notes.zh: 歷史最後版本建議冬菇先蒸，再連菇汁與雞同蒸。

name.en: Dried scallops or Jinhua ham, optional

steps.en: Bring stock, ginger and spring onion to a gentle simmer. Add chicken and optional dried scallop or ham; simmer until chicken is cooked through, skimming as needed.
steps.zh: 雞湯加入薑及蔥煮至微滾，放入雞件及可選瑤柱或火腿，小火煮至雞肉熟透，適時撇走浮沫。

steps.en: Soak or boil vermicelli according to its package directions. Drain and divide among bowls.
steps.zh: 按包裝指示浸或煮米粉，瀝乾後分入碗中。

steps.en: Remove chicken if serving in pieces. Bring broth to a gentle boil, add wontons and cook according to package directions; add greens for the final minutes.
steps.zh: 如要斬件上碟，可先取出雞肉。湯底輕滾後加入雲吞，按包裝時間煮熟，最後數分鐘加入青菜。

steps.en: Season broth with salt and white pepper. Ladle broth, wontons and chicken over vermicelli.
steps.zh: 以鹽及白胡椒調味，把湯、雲吞及雞肉淋在米粉上。

notes.en: Bacon and Jinhua ham were compared in the history: use bacon for a milky western-style broth, or a small amount of Jinhua ham for a traditional clear broth.
notes.zh: 歷史曾比較煙肉與金華火腿：奶香西式湯可用煙肉，中式清雞湯可用少量金華火腿。

title.en: Steamed pork patty with salted fish

steps.en: Mix pork with soy, sugar, cornflour, water, sesame oil and pepper. Stir in one direction until sticky.
steps.zh: 豬肉加入生抽、糖、生粉、水、麻油及白胡椒，順一方向攪至起膠。

steps.en: Rinse salted fish quickly if very salty, pat dry, remove bones and cut into small pieces. Fold half into the pork.
steps.zh: 鹹魚如太鹹可快速沖洗並抹乾，去骨切粒，一半拌入豬肉。

steps.en: Spread pork in a shallow plate and scatter remaining fish on top. Steam over boiling water for 15–18 minutes until thoroughly cooked.
steps.zh: 豬肉鋪入淺碟，面放餘下鹹魚。水滾後蒸15–18分鐘至熟透。

steps.en: Spoon the steaming juices over the patty and garnish with spring onion.
steps.zh: 將蒸汁淋回肉餅，撒上蔥花即成。

notes.en: Salted fish varies in saltiness; season lightly and taste the juices before adding more soy.
notes.zh: 鹹魚鹹度各異，調味宜輕手，試蒸汁後才考慮加豉油。

steps.en: Stir oyster sauce, soy sauces, sugar, sesame oil and hot water together.
steps.zh: 蠔油、生抽、老抽、糖、麻油及熱水拌勻。

steps.en: Boil noodles according to package directions. If using enoki, trim and fry separately until golden and crisp.
steps.zh: 按包裝指示煮麵。如用金菇，切去根部後另行炸至金黃酥脆。

steps.en: Drain noodles well, toss with sauce while hot, and top with spring onion and crispy shallots. Serve enoki alongside or on top.
steps.zh: 麵瀝乾後趁熱與醬汁拌勻，撒上蔥花及炸乾蔥。金菇可伴碟或鋪面。

notes.en: Keep any crispy enoki separate until serving so it stays crisp.
notes.zh: 炸金菇上桌前才放，保持酥脆。

title.en: Hong Kong fish noodles with garlic-soy dressing

steps.en: Mix soy, oyster sauce, sesame oil, water, sugar and white pepper. Warm briefly so the sugar dissolves.
steps.zh: 生抽、蠔油、麻油、水、糖及白胡椒拌勻，稍微加熱至糖溶。

steps.en: Boil fish noodles according to package directions. Reserve a little cooking water, then drain.
steps.zh: 按包裝指示煮魚麵，留少量麵水後瀝乾。

steps.en: Put dressing in a bowl, add hot noodles and toss. Add a spoon of noodle water if needed for a juicier coating.
steps.zh: 碗中先放醬汁，加入熱魚麵拌勻；想更濕潤可加一匙麵水。

steps.en: Top with crispy garlic, optional dried shrimp and spring onion.
steps.zh: 撒上炸蒜、可選蝦皮及蔥花。

notes.en: Add crispy garlic and dried shrimp at the end to retain their texture.
notes.zh: 炸蒜及蝦皮最後才加，保留酥香。

steps.en: Bring stock, garlic, soy and chilli oil to a simmer. Add beef balls and cook until heated through.
steps.zh: 高湯加入蒜蓉、生抽及辣椒油煮至微滾，放入牛丸煮熱。

steps.en: Cook noodles separately to package directions. Add pak choi to the broth for the final 2 minutes.
steps.zh: 麵條另按包裝煮熟。湯底最後2分鐘加入白菜。

steps.en: Divide noodles into bowls, ladle over broth and beef balls. Finish with spring onion, optional pepper oil and vinegar.
steps.zh: 麵條分碗，加入湯、牛丸及白菜，最後加蔥花、可選花椒油及黑醋。

notes.en: Adjust chilli oil and vinegar at the table. For a clearer soup, skim the stock before adding seasonings.
notes.zh: 辣油及醋可上桌後自行調整。想湯底清澈，可先撇走浮沫。

steps.en: Stir soy, oyster sauce, wine, sugar, cornflour and water together.
steps.zh: 生抽、蠔油、紹興酒、糖、生粉及水拌勻。

steps.en: Heat oil in a wok. Fry garlic and ginger briefly, add pork and break it up; cook until no longer pink.
steps.zh: 鑊中燒油，炒香蒜蓉及薑，加入豬肉碎炒散至轉色熟透。

steps.en: Add carrot and cabbage; stir-fry until just tender.
steps.zh: 加入甘筍及椰菜炒至剛軟。

steps.en: Pour in sauce and toss until glossy and thickened. Serve with rice.
steps.zh: 倒入醬汁兜勻至光亮濃稠，配白飯享用。

notes.en: Use the vegetables you have; add watery greens near the end to avoid excess liquid.
notes.zh: 可按手上蔬菜替換；出水較多的葉菜宜較後加入。

steps.en: Combine dashi, soy, mirin, sake and sugar in a pan. Add onion and simmer 3 minutes, then add chicken and cook through.
steps.zh: 高湯、生抽、味醂、清酒及糖放入鍋中，加入洋蔥煮3分鐘，再加入雞肉煮熟。

steps.en: Pour beaten egg over the chicken in two additions. Cover briefly until softly set, leaving it slightly tender.
steps.zh: 蛋液分兩次淋在雞肉上，短暫加蓋煮至蛋凝固但仍嫩滑。

steps.en: Spoon chicken, egg and sauce over hot rice; garnish with spring onion.
steps.zh: 雞肉、蛋及醬汁鋪在熱飯上，撒上蔥花。

notes.en: Use pasteurised eggs or cook until fully set for anyone who needs to avoid undercooked eggs.
notes.zh: 需要避免半熟蛋的人士，請使用巴士德消毒蛋或將雞蛋煮至全熟。

steps.en: Heat oil in a pot. Brown chicken pieces, then remove.
steps.zh: 鍋中燒油，雞肉煎至上色後盛起。

steps.en: Fry onion until softened. Add carrot, potatoes and tomatoes; stir for 2 minutes.
steps.zh: 炒軟洋蔥，加入甘筍、薯仔及番茄炒2分鐘。

steps.en: Return chicken, add stock and simmer 20–25 minutes until vegetables and chicken are cooked.
steps.zh: 雞肉回鍋，加入高湯小火煮20–25分鐘至肉菜熟透。

steps.en: Turn off heat, dissolve curry roux, then simmer gently until thick. Serve with rice.
steps.zh: 熄火加入咖喱磚攪溶，再小火煮至濃稠，配飯享用。

notes.en: Tomatoes bring extra acidity; add a small pinch of sugar if your tomatoes are particularly tart.
notes.zh: 番茄會增加酸度；如番茄偏酸，可加少量糖平衡。

steps.en: Boil potatoes in salted water until tender. Drain well and steam-dry briefly.
steps.zh: 薯仔以鹽水煮至軟身，瀝乾後稍作風乾。

steps.en: Lightly salt cucumber, carrot and onion; rest 10 minutes, then squeeze out excess water.
steps.zh: 青瓜、甘筍及洋蔥輕撒鹽，靜置10分鐘後擠出多餘水分。

steps.en: Coarsely mash warm potatoes, season with vinegar, salt and pepper; cool until just warm.
steps.zh: 薯仔趁暖粗略壓碎，加入醋、鹽及黑椒調味，放至微暖。

steps.en: Fold in vegetables, mayonnaise and optional chopped egg. Chill before serving.
steps.zh: 拌入蔬菜、蛋黃醬及可選熟蛋，冷藏後享用。

notes.en: Let potatoes cool before adding mayonnaise to keep the dressing creamy.
notes.zh: 薯仔放涼至微暖才加蛋黃醬，醬汁較滑。

steps.en: Blend chilled soy milk with sesame seeds and optional peanut butter until smooth. Season lightly with salt and chill.
steps.zh: 凍豆漿、芝麻及可選花生醬攪至順滑，以少量鹽調味並冷藏。

steps.en: Boil noodles according to package directions, rinse under cold water and drain well.
steps.zh: 按包裝煮麵，以凍水沖洗並徹底瀝乾。

steps.en: Divide noodles into bowls, pour over soy broth and top with cucumber, tomato and boiled egg.
steps.zh: 麵條分碗，倒入豆乳湯，配青瓜、番茄及熟蛋享用。

notes.en: Keep the soy broth very cold and add salt gradually; brands vary in sweetness and thickness.
notes.zh: 豆乳湯要保持冰涼，鹽逐少加入；不同豆漿甜度及濃度有別。

steps.en: Whisk gochujang, vinegar, soy, sugar and sesame oil until smooth.
steps.zh: 韓式辣醬、醋、生抽、糖及麻油拌至順滑。

steps.en: Boil noodles until tender, rinse thoroughly under cold water and drain.
steps.zh: 麵條煮至熟，以凍水徹底沖洗並瀝乾。

steps.en: Toss noodles with sauce. Top with cucumber, boiled egg and sesame seeds.
steps.zh: 麵條與醬汁拌勻，放上青瓜、熟蛋及芝麻。

notes.en: Adjust chilli paste and vinegar to taste; add a spoonful of cold water if the sauce is too thick.
notes.zh: 辣醬及醋按口味調整；醬汁太稠可加一匙凍水。

title.zh: 吞拿魚蛋黃醬泡菜炒飯

steps.en: Heat a little oil and stir-fry kimchi for 2–3 minutes until fragrant.
steps.zh: 燒少許油，泡菜炒2–3分鐘至香。

steps.en: Add drained tuna and cold rice; break up clumps and stir-fry until steaming hot. Season with soy.
steps.zh: 加入吞拿魚及冷飯炒散至熱透，以生抽調味。

steps.en: Stir in mayonnaise and sesame oil. Fry eggs separately and serve on top with spring onion and sesame seeds.
steps.zh: 拌入蛋黃醬及麻油。雞蛋另煎，鋪在炒飯上，撒蔥花及芝麻。

notes.en: Use freshly cooked rice cooled quickly or refrigerated leftover rice; reheat until piping hot.
notes.zh: 可用迅速放涼或冷藏的剩飯，翻熱至熱透。
